about_the_game:
Demonsomnia is a CO-OP multiplayer body cam horror game about the impact of a nuclear reaction. Grab your gun, head to the forest and collect the objects you need to hunt the demon from the misty woods. The forest is full of villagers and strange mutated creatures.



With the highest performance and highest graphics for CO-OP games, this game was developed with Unreal Engine 5!






  • Body Camera: You have a body camera. When you see various beings, use the radio and report them to your friends, if they are still alive.
  • Equipment: Find spots where the radiation is intense, there are useful items in these spots, such as radiation salt. You will use these items to hunt the demon. There are also many tools you will need to hunt the demon.
  • Buy guns: Weapons like pistols or machine guns will make you feel safe when you are alone. Remember, sometimes they are your only friends...



  • Co-OP: You can play with your friends or other players at any time. It has LAN and online features.
  • Teamwork: Work in harmony with your friends, cooperate with your team and maybe even lead them. Everyone needs a leader from time to time, maybe you are the leader they need.

To investigate the effects of the nuclear reaction, the government has recruited 4 brave people, and you are one of them. Are these various beings created by radiation, mutated species, hallucinations, or unidentified beings?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains extremely scary elements and blood.
Anyone under the age limit should not play.
Anyone with certain illnesses should not play.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430 / AMD FX-6300
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700

short_description: Demonsomnia is a CO-OP multiplayer bodycam horror game about the impact of a nuclear reaction. Radiation has spread everywhere, put on your gas mask, go to the forest, collect objects and return to the mansion. Your goal is to collect evidence with the equipment and hunt the demon in the mansion.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian
